Limited to the orientations present in the pre-computed bands, though steerable filters allow interpolation [S1, S2].

The claim states that the method is limited to orientations present in pre-computed bands, but steerable filters allow interpolation. The evidence in both sources confirms that the noise bands are pre-computed with specific orientations (typically four or eight). It explicitly states that the construction is based on steerable filters, which are 'steerable in orientation,' meaning 'a linear interpolation of the filters can generate a filter with exactly the same profile, but at an intermediate orientation.' This interpolation capability allows the system to approximate any desired frequency spectrum by combining the pre-computed bands, effectively bridging the gap between the discrete pre-computed orientations.
